name: Positional Encoding with Linear Annealing
definition: A positional encoding function that applies linear annealing to frequency bands based on a progress parameter, masking lower frequencies at progress=0 and exposing all at progress=1.
summary: Positional Encoding with Linear Annealing stabilizes neural field training by progressively exposing higher frequencies using a simple linear clamp mask, differing from other methods that use smooth windowing kernels.
